name: Education Loan Scheme (NSFDC)
teName: విద్యా రుణ పథకం (ఎన్. ఎస్. ఎఫ్. డి. సి)
teBrief: ఈ పథకాన్ని జాతీయ షెడ్యూల్డ్ కులాల ఆర్థిక మరియు అభివృద్ధి సంస్థ, సామాజిక న్యాయం మరియు సాధికారత మంత్రిత్వ శాఖ, భారత ప్రభుత్వం అమలు చేసింది.
ministry: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance And Development Corporation
brief: The "Education Loan Scheme" is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India.
briefFull: The scheme implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance & Development Corporation, Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Govt. of India. Under this Scheme, loan is provided for pursuing full-time Professional/Technical courses in recognized institutions as one time assistance.
details:
The "Education Loan Scheme" is implemented by the National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC) under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India. Under this Scheme, the loan is provided for pursuing full-time Professional/Technical courses in recognized institutions as one-time assistance. The Educational Loan shall cover Admission Fee, Tuition Fee, Books, Stationery, Equipment, Examination Fee, Hostel and Mess Expenses, Insurance Premium for Policy for insuring loanees against loan in case of death or permanent disability, Travel Expenses/Passage Money including Visa Expenses for studying abroad, Caution Money, Development Fund, Clothing Allowance including weather protective clothing in extreme climate (in case of foreign study).
**Professional/Technical Courses Covered:** Educational Loans shall be provided to eligible students for pursuing regular full-time Professional/Technical recognized courses approved by the Government in the following fields in India or abroad:

  - Engineering (Diploma/ B.Tech /B.E, M.Tech/M.E.)
  - Architecture (B.Arch/M.Arch)
  - Medical (MBBS/MD/MS)
  - Biotechnology/Microbiology/Clinical Technology (Diploma/Degree)
  - Pharmacy (B.Pharma/M.Pharma)
  - Dental (BDS/MDS)
  - Physiotherapy (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
  - Pathology (B.Sc/M.Sc.)
  - Nursing (B.Sc./M.Sc.)
  - Information Technology (BCA/MCA)
  - Management (BBA/MBA)
  - Hotel Management & Catering Technology (Diploma /Graduation/Post Graduation)
  - Law (LLB/LLM)
  - Education (CT/NTT/B.Ed/M.Ed)
  - Education (CT/NTT/B.Ed/M.Ed)
  - Physical Education (C.PEd./B.PEd/ M.PEd)
  - Journalism & Mass Communication (Graduation/Post Graduation)
  - Geriatric Care (Diploma/Post Graduate Diploma)
  - Midwifery (Diploma)
  - Laboratory Technician (Diploma)
  - Chartered Accountancy (CA)
  - Cost Accountancy (ICWA)
  - Company Secretaryship (CS)
  - Actuarial Sciences (Graduation/ Post Graduation/FIA)
  - Associate Member of the Institute of Engineers (AMIE) and Institute of Electronics & Telecommunication
  - Higher education like Doctoral Studies leading to M.Phil/PhD from recognized institutions.
benefits:
**Maximum Loan Limit:**

  - **Up to ₹30,00,000/-** (for studies in India) and **upto ₹40,00,000/-** (for studies abroad) or 90% of course fee, whichever is less.
**Rate of Interest:**

  - **For studies in India:** NSFDC shall charge interest @ 2% per annum from the SCAs, which in turn, shall charge 6% per annum from the beneficiaries. In case of women beneficiaries, an interest rebate of 0.5% is provided.  - **For studies abroad:** NSFDC shall charge interest @ 3% per annum from the SCAs, which in turn, shall charge 7% per annum from the beneficiaries. In case of women beneficiaries, an interest rebate of 0.5% is provided.
**Repayment Period:**
The maximum repayment period under the Educational Loan Scheme is as under:-

  - **For Loan up to ₹10,00,000/-:** Within 10 years  - **For Loan above ₹10,00,000/-:** Within 12 years
eligibility:
1. The applicant should be a student pursuing regular full-time Professional or Technical courses in a recognized institution in India or abroad.
   1. The applicant should belong to a Scheduled Caste community.
   1. The applicant's annual family income should be less than ₹3,00,000/-, both in rural and urban areas.
   1. The education loan assistance will be provided as a one-time assistance.
howToApply:
[Offline]
**Step 1:** The applicants should contact the District Office of State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) if they wish to avail NSFDC Education loan.
**Step 2:** The applicants are required to submit the [application in NSFDC's format](https://nsfdc.nic.in/UploadedFiles/other/2023-10-09/els%20loan%20format.pdf) with their details at the District Office of State Channelizing Agencies.
**Step 3:** The District Offices of SCAs/CAs scrutinize the applications to ensure they meet the eligibility criteria.
**Step 4:** The District Offices forward the scrutinized applications to their respective Head Offices for further processing.
**Step 5:** The Head Offices of SCAs/CAs examine the loan proposals and after examination, loan proposals are recommended for sanction and forwarded to NSFDC along with the SCAs' recommendations.
**Step 6:** The Project and Banking Desk at NSFDC appraises the loan proposals submitted by the SCAs/CAs. An appraisal report is prepared and submitted to the Project Clearance Committee (PCC) for concurrence.
**Step 7:** The PCC reviews the appraisal report and, if found in order, recommends the proposals for sanction. Sanction Letters, known as Letters of Intent (LOIs), along with Terms & Conditions, are issued to the SCAs/RRBs/Public Sector Banks/NBFC-MFIs for acceptance.
**Step 8:** After acceptance of the sanction terms and fulfillment of the Prudential Norms, funds are disbursed by NSFDC to the SCAs/RRBs/Public Sector Banks/NBFC-MFIs. The SCAs/RRBs/Public Sector Banks/NBFC-MFIs then disburse these funds to the beneficiaries.
**Step 9:** Beneficiaries repay the loans as per the repayment schedule stipulated by the SCAs/CAs.

1. Passport-size photograph
   1. Aadhaar Card
   1. Income certificate
   1. Caste certificate
   1. Residence proof
   1. Valid Passport (For Study Abroad)
   1. Valid Visa/Permit (If any for study abroad)
   1. Educational qualification certificates
   1. Copy of admission confirmation from an educational institute with fee and other charges payment schedule yearly
   1. Copy of Identity card issued by the Institute if admission has already taken
   1. Any other documents as required

te.howToApply:
[Offline]
**దశ 1:** దరఖాస్తుదారులు ఎన్ఎస్ఎఫ్డిసి విద్యా రుణాన్ని పొందాలనుకుంటే రాష్ట్ర ఛానలైజింగ్ ఏజెన్సీల (ఎస్సిఎ) జిల్లా కార్యాలయాన్ని సంప్రదించాలి. **దశ 2:** దరఖాస్తుదారులు తమ వివరాలతో [ఎన్ఎస్ఎఫ్డిసి ఫార్మాట్లో దరఖాస్తును](https://nsfdc.nic.in/UploadedFiles/other/2023-10-09/els%20loan%20format.pdf) రాష్ట్ర ఛానలైజింగ్ ఏజెన్సీల జిల్లా కార్యాలయంలో సమర్పించాల్సి ఉంటుంది. దశ 3: ఎస్సిఎలు/సిఎల జిల్లా కార్యాలయాలు దరఖాస్తులు అర్హత ప్రమాణాలకు అనుగుణంగా ఉన్నాయని నిర్ధారించడానికి వాటిని పరిశీలిస్తాయి. దశ 4: జిల్లా కార్యాలయాలు పరిశీలించిన దరఖాస్తులను తదుపరి ప్రాసెసింగ్ కోసం ఆయా ప్రధాన కార్యాలయాలకు పంపుతాయి. దశ 5: ఎస్సిఎలు/సిఎల ప్రధాన కార్యాలయాలు రుణ ప్రతిపాదనలను పరిశీలించి, పరిశీలించిన తరువాత, రుణ ప్రతిపాదనలు మంజూరు కోసం సిఫార్సు చేయబడతాయి మరియు ఎస్సిఎల సిఫార్సులతో పాటు ఎన్ఎస్ఎఫ్డిసికి పంపబడతాయి. దశ 6: ఎన్ఎస్ఎఫ్డిసిలోని ప్రాజెక్ట్ మరియు బ్యాంకింగ్ డెస్క్ ఎస్సిఎలు/సిఎలు సమర్పించిన రుణ ప్రతిపాదనలను అంచనా వేస్తుంది. ఒక మదింపు నివేదికను తయారు చేసి, సమ్మతి కోసం ప్రాజెక్ట్ క్లియరెన్స్ కమిటీ (పిసిసి) కి సమర్పిస్తారు. **దశ 7:** పీసీసీ మదింపు నివేదికను సమీక్షించి, క్రమంలో కనిపిస్తే, మంజూరు కోసం ప్రతిపాదనలను సిఫారసు చేస్తుంది. లెటర్స్ ఆఫ్ ఇంటెంట్ (ఎల్ఓఐ) అని పిలువబడే మంజూరు లేఖలు, నిబంధనలు మరియు షరతులతో పాటు, ఎస్సీఏలు/ఆర్ఆర్బీలు/ప్రభుత్వ రంగ బ్యాంకులు/ఎన్బీఎఫ్సీ-ఎంఎఫ్ఐలకు ఆమోదం కోసం జారీ చేయబడతాయి. దశ 8: మంజూరు నిబంధనలను ఆమోదించి, వివేకవంతమైన నిబంధనలను నెరవేర్చిన తరువాత, ఎన్ఎస్ఎఫ్డిసి ద్వారా ఎస్సిఎలు/ఆర్ఆర్బి లు/ప్రభుత్వ రంగ బ్యాంకులు/ఎన్బిఎఫ్సి-ఎంఎఫ్ఐలకు నిధులు పంపిణీ చేయబడతాయి. ఎస్సీఏలు/ఆర్ఆర్బీలు/ప్రభుత్వ రంగ బ్యాంకులు/ఎన్బీఎఫ్సీ-ఎంఎఫ్ఐలు ఈ నిధులను లబ్ధిదారులకు పంపిణీ చేస్తాయి. **దశ 9:** లబ్ధిదారులు ఎస్సిఎలు/సిఎలు నిర్దేశించిన తిరిగి చెల్లింపు షెడ్యూల్ ప్రకారం రుణాలను తిరిగి చెల్లిస్తారు.

faqs.a: NSFDC stands for National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation. It was set up by the Government of India under Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment (MOSJ&E) on 8th February, 1989 under Section 25 of the Companies Act, 1956 as a company 'not for profit'. Now, it is Section 8 Company (not-for-profit) under campanies Act, 2013.

faqs.q: What is the Contact Address of NSFDC?
faqs.a: NSFDC has its Head Office at Delhi and its full address and contact number is :- National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation 14th Floor, SCOPE Minar, Core 1 & 2, Laxmi Nagar, Delhi ? 110 092 Tele: 011-22054392, 22054394, 22054396. Fax: 011-22054395 E-mail : support-nsfdc[@]nic[dot]in Website : www.nsfdc.nic.in It has three Liasion Centers  at Mumbai, Kolkata, and Bengaluru.

faqs.q: What is the main objective of NSFDC?
faqs.a: NSFDC's main objective is to finance, facilitate and mobilize funds for the economic empowerment of persons belonging to the Scheduled Caste families having annual family income up to  ₹3,00,000/-.
faqs.qTe: ఎన్. ఎస్. ఎఫ్. డి. సి. ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం ఏమిటి?

faqs.q: For which Educational courses, the Educational Loan is provided by NSFDC?
faqs.a:
The Educational Loan is provided for the courses run by the recognized Educational Institutions. Presently, it is provided for pursuing following full time professional/technical courses:-
1. Full time Professional/Technical courses in the fields of Engineering, Medical, Dental, Management, Information Technology, Hotel Management, Architecture, Physiotherapy, Bio-Technology, Law, Education, Journalism etc.
2. Professional courses like CA/ICWA/CS/AMIE/FIA/IETE.
3. Higher education like Doctoral Studies leading to M.Phil/PhD from recognized institutions.
faqs.qTe: ఏయే విద్యా కోర్సులకు ఎన్ఎస్ఎఫ్డిసి విద్యా రుణాన్ని అందిస్తుంది?

faqs.q: What expenses are covered under this loan scheme?
faqs.a: The loan covers admission fees, tuition fees, books, stationery, equipment, examination fees, hostel and mess expenses, insurance premiums, travel expenses for studying abroad, caution money, development fund, clothing allowance, and other related expenses.
faqs.qTe: ఈ రుణ పథకం కింద ఏ ఖర్చులు కవర్ చేయబడతాయి?

faqs.q: What is the maximum loan amount for studies in India?
faqs.a: The maximum loan amount for studies in India is ₹30,00,000/- or 90% of the course fee, whichever is less.

faqs.q: What is the maximum loan amount for studies abroad?
faqs.a: The maximum loan amount for studies abroad is ₹40,00,000/- or 90% of the course fee, whichever is less.

faqs.q: What is the rate of interest for loans taken for studies in India?
faqs.a: NSFDC charges 2% per annum from SCAs, which charge 6% per annum from beneficiaries. Women beneficiaries receive an interest rebate of 0.5%.
faqs.qTe: భారతదేశంలో చదువుల కోసం తీసుకున్న రుణాలపై వడ్డీ రేటు ఎంత?

faqs.q: What is the rate of interest for loans taken for studies abroad?
faqs.a: NSFDC charges 3% per annum from SCAs, which charge 7% per annum from beneficiaries. Women beneficiaries receive an interest rebate of 0.5%.
faqs.qTe: విదేశాలలో చదువుకోవడానికి తీసుకున్న రుణాలపై వడ్డీ రేటు ఎంత?

faqs.q: What is the repayment period for loans up to ₹10,00,000/-?
faqs.a: The repayment period for loans up to ₹10,00,000/- is within 10 years.

faqs.q: What is the repayment period for loans above ₹10,00,000/-?
faqs.a: The repayment period for loans above ₹10,00,000/- is within 12 years.
faqs.qTe: ₹ 10,00,000-కంటే ఎక్కువ రుణాలకు తిరిగి చెల్లించే కాలం ఎంత?

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for this loan?
faqs.a: Students pursuing full-time professional or technical courses in recognized institutions in India or abroad who belong to Scheduled Castes and whose annual family income is less than ₹3,00,000/- are eligible.
faqs.qTe: ఈ రుణం కోసం దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవడానికి ఎవరు అర్హులు?

faqs.q: How can I apply for the Education Loan Scheme?
faqs.a: Applicants should contact the District Office of the State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs) and submit their application in the prescribed NSFDC format.
faqs.qTe: విద్యా రుణ పథకం కోసం నేను ఎలా దరఖాస్తు చేసుకోవచ్చు?

faqs.q: Can the loan be used for studying part-time courses?
faqs.a: No, the loan is only available for full-time regular professional or technical courses.
faqs.qTe: ఈ రుణాన్ని పార్ట్ టైమ్ కోర్సుల అధ్యయనానికి ఉపయోగించవచ్చా?
